literal_meaning: তালা বা বন্ধকের নড়া (lock or bolt moving)
figurative_meaning_bn: চৈতন্যোদয় হওয়া, বুঝে ওঠা; সজাগ হওয়া; হুঁশ হওয়া
figurative_meaning_en: To become aware or conscious, to understand or realize; to become alert; to snap to attention
similar_in_english: Wake up and smell the coffee
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে কথা শুনে তার টনক নড়ে গেল।
example_sentences_in_english: Hearing that, he suddenly became aware.
note: Refers to the movement of a lock's bolt, metaphorically indicating mental awakening.
